label: Radix Colors
notes: The healthy control. 6 light base scales (slate, blue, red, green, amber, plum) x 12 deliberately-even steps = 72 swatches, zero intentional duplicates. p3 @supports overrides are present in source and are skipped by the css-custom-props adapter (color(display-p3 ...) is not a recognised color form). Expect a long clean plateau at ~72 then a monotone collapse: this fixture exists to show the ΔE metric is well-behaved on a well-governed palette. Only the 6 light non-alpha scales were vendored to keep the snapshot legible; dark/alpha/other scales omitted.
